headline: Indian Rupee Strengthens to Six-and-a-Half-Month High Against USD
summary: The Indian rupee strengthened to close at 93.90 per U.S. dollar, gaining 57 paise from the previous close.
why: Currency appreciation against the US dollar impacts import costs, domestic inflation, and foreign portfolio investment valuations in emerging markets.
